transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the weekly water-systems review. Before I approve the potable-water board, I need to hear from each of you. Logistics, utilities, medical — please report any confirmed updates or changes that affect our water distribution. That includes the South Tank Wednesday release, the North Tank pump maintenance scheduled Thursday 0900 to 1100, and the Clinic Tank 3,000-gallon reserve. Go ahead.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I have a confirmed update from today's pump inspection. The North Tank pump needs its scheduled service moved from Thursday 0900 to 1100 to Friday 1300 to 1500. The replacement seal arrives Friday morning, so we can't do the service on Thursday as currently scheduled. I haven't updated the maintenance work order yet, but this is a confirmed change that affects the water distribution board.
